verdict.rationale: Published per-unit pricing is a fair question for a hosted backend platform like Supabase, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no pricing page, no per-unit rates for compute, storage, or egress, and no cost-estimation material. The only plan mention (Pro/Team/Enterprise in the backups doc) concerns backup eligibility, not prices.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing
